company.name: Verdant
company.shortDescription: Verdant provides accounting, tax preparation and planning, marketing and wealth management services.
company.description: Verdant offers an approach that occurs beyond the months of tax season. With accounting at the core, they work to build themselves and their business a plan to grow into the future. They focus on everything from traditional to digital media marketing as well as assess how their current marketing plan ranks among their competition. They offer Marketing and Strategy Services such as Advertising Audit, Advertising Strategy, Advertising Management, Strategic Planning, Social Media Marketing, Market Analysis, Brand Analysis, and Digital Marketing.
